title: Momoi Airi — Cat Sister Mischief!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. Taking that detour was the right call. I can't believe how much cute stuff they had...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've been meaning to check out that general store for a while now. And I got some great shopping done!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (There's still a lot I wanna get, so I'll go back again sometime...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, that looks like...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Isn't that Mizuki?
Hey, Mizuki!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Over here!
Fancy seeing you here. You're in your uniform. Are you just coming back from school?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Airi!
Yeah, I decided to go today for a change.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? That bag you're holding...
Did you go to that general store by the park?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you're as sharp as ever!
It was my first time going, and I thought it was really great.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I didn't realize they carried so much cat merch...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The mittens and aprons they had were so cute. Actually, they had so much adorable stuff that I spent like an hour deciding what to buy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that place does have a ton of cat stuff! I also have trouble deciding what to get every time I go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, what did you buy today?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A pair of mittens.
I really wanted to get some more things, but I decided to hold off until my next visit.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like they have a new regular now. Oh, speaking of cat merch, have you already checked out the shop that just opened up by the station?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course I've already checked it out.
I went right when it first opened, and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, I'm thinking about turning a corner of my room into a sort of cat sanctuary! I'm trying to find the cutest position for each piece of merch I have.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You really do have a passion for cats, don't you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's because they're so cute!
Just the other day, this stray that lives near my house... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Over there...
Are they setting up for an event or something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, look at that.
That looks like a Ferris wheel, and that other thing might be a roller coaster... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come to think of it, some people were talking about how a carnival was coming to town!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I also saw some people talking about that on social media!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It caught my eye since carnivals are a pretty rare sight around here, but I never got around to checking any details.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me neither! What do you think it's gonna be like? Maybe there's some past info about it online.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's try taking a look!
Let's see... “Shibuya” plus “carnival”...

rows.Speaker: Airi & Mizuki
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I-It's a cat-themed carnival...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Look at this merry-go-round!
They have cats instead of horses! It's way too cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
These teacups are also covered in cats!
White ones, black ones and... Oh, they even have a tabby teacup!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No... Th-This is...
A must-visit for a cat lover!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the merch they have is totally off the hook...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really?! No, I'm too scared to look. I mean, if the pics of the rides packed that much of a punch...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, I wanna see...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nooo! L-Look at all the plushies they have...!
They even have cat headbands and tote bags. It really is a cat carnival!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And their mascot, Mikke...!
He's so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, they even have someone dressed as him walking around... And you can take pictures with him!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! Does that mean we can ask him to do different poses...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, probably!
Take a look at these pics. He's striking different poses in all of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No way... That's so generous of him!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I've never seen a carnival that's all about cats like this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The people running it must really love them...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. We absolutely gotta go...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When does it open? Next week...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you happen to be free around then, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm usually free, so I should be able to go whenever! How's your schedule looking, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's see, I... Oh!
We don't have any practices or streams scheduled for this weekend.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Then, I'll leave this day open!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I already can't wait...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We get to spend an entire day swimming in cats!
